n: MIT K12 Maker Literary Mapping with Ozobots
t: A grade 5 project where Ozobots trace a story journey on a poster map.
steps: Find the Literary Mapping With Ozobots project from MIT K12 Maker.
Gather red, blue, black and green markers.
Have one Ozobot Bit for each group.
Read the novel with the class.
Have groups label the six stops.
Mark the route and let the robot trace it.
